Hymn 300: Families Can Be Together Forever
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: F Major
Composer: Vanja Y. Watkins
Lyricist/Text Author: Ruth Muir Gardner
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 300 titled "Families Can Be Together Forever" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Vanja Y. Watkins and the lyrics were written by Ruth Muir Gardner.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
